name: treasury
description: Agent Treasury by Tempora Labs — treasury management plugin for AI agents; your own wallet holds the position. The earn skill puts idle USDC to work in ERC-4626 vaults on Base, Arbitrum One, Ethereum and Monad, a Kamino vault on Solana, and idle USDG on Robinhood Chain: lists the vaults and their status from the Tempora API (Solana from the chain), checks every step the API prepares before your wallet sees it, and returns UNSIGNED approve/deposit/withdraw steps for your own signer, or opens a local page where you confirm them in your own wallet (a browser wallet, or an email or social login). Holds no keys; cannot sign or send.
